sources.label: 模型边界 — 平面 2D 机械臂：关节为理想铰链，不含动力学、重力、摩擦、减速箱间隙与自碰撞；基座限位 ±100°（落地臂不穿地板），其余关节 ±150°，限位在每次前向传递后钳制（FABRIK 原论文建议的约束扩展），逼近真实限位而非精确约束求解；雅可比转置的步长增益为手调稳定值（原论文中 α 即为用户给定标量）；画面单位约等于厘米，慢放播放的每一帧都是求解器真实的迭代序列
sources.labelEn: Model boundary — a planar 2D arm: joints are ideal hinges with no dynamics, gravity, friction, gearbox backlash or self-collision; the base joint is limited to ±100° (a floor-mounted arm cannot pass through the floor) and the rest to ±150°, clamped after each forward pass (the constraint extension suggested in the original FABRIK paper), an approximation of true limited joints rather than exact constrained optimisation; the Jacobian-transpose gain is hand-tuned for stability (alpha is a user-supplied scalar in the source paper); on-screen units read as centimetres, and every slow-motion frame is the solver’s real iteration sequence
